content.document_title: 2020 ACC/AHA Guideline for the Management of Valvular Heart Disease

key_points: Discusses perioperative outcomes of aortic stenosis in noncardiac surgeries.
Considers the impact of severe aortic stenosis on patients undergoing noncardiac surgery.
Addresses areas like prevention of valve disease, the role of imaging in aortic stenosis, and the timing of interventions.
Reviews potential genetic and systemic factors influencing valvular heart disease.

genes.context: TGF-β signaling and reactive oxygen species drive fibrosis and matrix remodeling in myxomatous mitral valves.
